messages:
Alex: Heads-up — Larchway dedicated switchover tonight 02:00 UTC (customer slice 3). Planning to flip traffic to build `r12.2.1-optimized` with v2-quant model. Need final go/no-go by 01:30 UTC. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood/inference/larchway-switchover
Priya: Acked for product. Release notes draft: https://docs.redwood/releases/larchway-2026-03-21 — will push final after cutover
Leah: SRE prechecks: canaries running in us-west-2. Current 5m error 0.02%, 95p latency 78ms. KV cache priming in progress.
Marco: Quick Q — are we pinning to v2-quant or allowing fallback? We need explicit rollback steps if pinning.
Alex: We will pin to `v2-quant` for this release. Rollback plan: immediate traffic shift to `v1-compat` slice. Command is `traffic_shift --tenant larchway --to v1-compat --percent 100` (manual or deploy-bot).
EngOps: Note — KMS rotation was scheduled at 03:00 UTC in infra. We will pause rotation for this tenant window. Confirmed.
deploy-bot: Preflight: starting health checks
deploy-bot: Preflight results: ok: cluster-health, ok: disk-space, warn: model-warmup (1/3 shards warming), ok: infra-alarms
Leah: model-warmup at 85% on shard-7, still warming. Recommend delay 20m.
Priya: Customer has a CET morning constraint. They pushed for earlier slot. Can we compromise to 02:30 UTC instead of 02:00?
Alex: New proposal: cutover at 02:30 UTC. Final ack by 01:45 UTC. Rollback thresholds to enforce:
  - sustained error rate > 1.5% over 3m
  - 95p latency > 300ms over 3m
  - >2 OOMs on any serving node within 10m
  - KV cache miss rate spike > 30% relative to baseline
  - model-mismatch (output validation failures) > 2%
Marco: +1 on thresholds. Also add "unexpected model version responses" alert (model id mismatch).
ops-bot: Alert policy updated: added rules and routed to @oncall-sre and #eng-oncall.
Maya: CS will notify the customer contact (Jonas) and run a quick staging smoke with token I just sent.
deploy-bot: Dry-run traffic shift: 10% -> `v2-quant` performed. Metrics check: no regressions in 30m window.
Leah: Dry-run looks clean. SRE final readiness: OK. Warming at 100% now.
EngOps: KMS pause enacted. Infra team standing by for quick rollback ops.
Alex: Go for 02:30 UTC with canary strategy: 10% for 10m, 50% next 10m, then 100% if canary stable. @deploy-bot schedule and post updates here.
deploy-bot: Cutover scheduled for 02:30 UTC. Will post canonical updates.
(02:30) deploy-bot: Canary 10% started. Canary dashboard: https://pulse.redwood/canary/1768889999
(02:40) Leah: Canary 10% stable. Error rate 0.01%, 95p +6ms. Proceeding to 50% ramp.
(02:50) Marco: Ramp to 50% done. Monitoring 5m windows closely.
(03:00) deploy-bot: Ramp to 100% complete. Observability: no OOMs, error rate normal.
(03:05) Leah: Post-cutover metrics look good. No model mismatch alerts. KV cache miss rate within expected bounds.
Priya: Customer confirms traffic on new build, no complaints. Thanks team :tada:
Alex: Closing — will update release notes with final timestamp and artifacts (canary link, rollbacks, metrics). If anything creeps up, reopen thread.
